attacks.name: Porker Hijinx
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Slow|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.
|!critical| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
|!block||!hit||!hit| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_small|.
|!critical||!hit||!hit| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, Push the defender |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Here's Pie in Your Eye
steps: |!wild| |*Shock|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§shock§Shock| special condition.

attacks.name: Who's You Calling a Cartoon?
steps: |*Outrageously Oversized Cartoon Hammer|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender has the Shock and Stun special conditions, it gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Web Yoink
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 4 and roll a die. On a |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!hit| result, if the chosen character is |!size| 3 or less, Push it Toward this character |!movement_small|. On any other result, Push this character Toward the chosen character |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Animation Domination
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer 1 or more |!damage|, it reduces the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1 to a minimum of 1.

superPowers.name: Spider-Nonsense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.|\| Additionally, when this character suffers |!damage|, after the effect is resolved, it drops any objective tokens it is holding.
